meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把你的 claude-mem 操作记录按项目、类型等条件汇集成一个“语料库”（知识库），加载后你能向它连续提问，它会从语料库中作答。它还支持列出、重建、重新加载语料库。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史创建聚焦的“大脑”、询问过去工作模式的问题，或编译特定主题的专业知识时触发。

say.text: 把关于 hooks 的所有观察建成一个知识库
say.note: 调用 build_corpus 创建语料库。

say.text: 查询这个知识库：hooks 生命周期有哪些钩子？
say.note: 调用 query_corpus 从语料库回答。

say.text: 重建 hooks 知识库并重新加载

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can aggregate your claude-mem observation history into queryable corpora by filters like project or type. After loading, you can ask follow-up questions and get answers from the corpus. It can also list, rebuild, and reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: Use this when you want to create a focused 'brain' from your observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from all observations about hooks.
Query this knowledge base: what are the hook lifecycle hooks and when do they fire?
say_en.note: Answers from the corpus via query_corpus.

say_en.text: Rebuild the hooks knowledge base and reload it.
